just for you, my baby

A letter for Vivii 💌

୨୧ ─ ♡ ─ ୨୧
My Vivii, You're the sunshine to my world, the painting I could look at for eternity, and genuinely the GOAT. You're my baby, my life, my heart, and the other 99% of my soul. (I'm keeping that 1% for remembering where I put my phone.) There is something about you that makes even an ordinary day feel special. I could look at you a thousand times and still find another little thing to adore. If the world were a gallery, I'd still walk straight past every painting just to find yours. I love you in the big, obvious ways and in the tiny everyday ways too. I love the memories we've already made, the ridiculous things that make us laugh, and the thought of all the moments we haven't reached yet. You are my favourite person, my soft place to land, my sunshine on a cloudy day, and the girl I want to keep choosing. No fancy website could fit everything I feel, but I made you this little one because you deserve reminders that you're loved. I love you, Vivii. More than this page can hold. 🌻
Always yours, with all my heart ♡

The silly corner 🍫

Scientific findings from the Department of Being Down Bad.

🍫

Silk Oreo economics: one Silk Oreo is technically a snack. Two is a shared experience. Three means the evidence has been eaten and the case is closed.

💬

Reply-time science: I can open an app in 0.2 seconds, but if you text me something cute, suddenly I need a full committee meeting to reply without sounding like a lovesick potato.

🧠

Memory storage: My brain has limited space, yet it has reserved premium, ad-free storage for random little things about you.

🐐

Official ranking: You are the GOAT. I am the unpaid intern responsible for reminding you of this fact.

🌻

Sunflower logic: sunflowers follow the sun. I follow you. Botanists have no further questions.
